comparisons.reason: Both are any-comment binary features over OC_comments, but the constructs differ. Feature 0 counts any particularized example, including hypothetical or scenario cases, used to illustrate a point, and it explicitly does not require the example to be real-world. Feature 1 requires specific empirical evidence such as data, statistics, studies or documented real-world cases, and it explicitly excludes hypotheticals. A hypothetical scenario would be 1 for feature 0 and 0 for feature 1. Feature 0 also has an explicit exclusion for examples quoted from the OP that feature 1 lacks.
